# Gossip frames

The gossip `Frame` enum (`crates/rdm-transport/src/topology.rs`): what travels on a mesh channel or the backbone, one postcard frame. The complete gossip message is postcard `(Vec<(String, String)>, Vec<u8>)`: standard CloudEvents metadata followed by opaque data selected by its literal type. The metadata names are `specversion`, `id`, `source`, `type`, `subject`, optional `sequence`, `time`, and `datacontenttype`; source names the original author birth. A frame below describes domain data, in declaration order, without an outer kind discriminant on the wire. The numeric column is an internal schema index, never a wire kind. In-process carriers marked serde skip are omitted. MeshTopology publication identity in data is `(fabric_id, node_id, incarnation, counter)`; the Rust frame retains the counter alongside its authored context. A field with a serde `with` module travels in that module's wire shape, so its Rust type is not followed. The workspace types the other fields carry follow, sorted by name.
